VERDICT: FAIL

The acceptance criteria explicitly require all three features. The third-party reviewer confirmed (A) per-key limits and (B) burst allowance, but found NO structured audit logging (C). The passing tests do not override this gap—they likely lack coverage for the audit logging requirement, which is why the self-report's "all tests pass" claim is consistent with the missing feature. Since (C) is absent, not all acceptance criteria are satisfied.
